name: tag
description: Names that entities answer to, so that other entities find them without holding a reference: the player, the board, the score keeper, the goal. A Tag names an item of the game's "tag" list; the modules that look an entity up by name (a text or a bar that shows a number, a rule, a record, the end of a path) read it. When several entities share a tag, the oldest one is found. Modules find tagged entities with ge/mod/tag/find.hpp.
